subject: Quick question after our discovery — is this on your Q3 roadmap?
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Smith <evan@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-30T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery notes & suggested next step

Hi Evan —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and a suggested next step so this doesn't sit in Slack: 

- Problem you described: inconsistent latency on embedding lookups at 99th percentile during peak batch transfers (~200ms spikes) and auditability requirements for usage logging.
- What we showed: Redwood inference routing to a dedicated quantized embedding model, prefix caching to cut repeated token work, and per-token trace logs you can stream to your observability pipeline.
- Suggested pilot: 2-week pilot against a representative namespace (prod shadow) with a capped 50k token/day budget, telemetry only writeback. Deliverables: latency dashboard, cost delta report, and noise-reduction checklist.

I attached a short one-pager with the pilot scope and an example milestones spreadsheet. If that looks reasonable, can we lock a 30-min kickoff next week? My availability: Tue/Wed mornings PST.

Thanks — feel free to loop in anyone on product or ops who should see the pilot scope.

--
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: Discovery-Recap-BlueWave.pdf (6 pages), Suggested-Pilot-Scope.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Hi Evan —

Wanted to surface this again since I haven't heard back after you were going to check with product and infra. Two quick asks — can you do either one?

1) Quick feedback: on a 1-5 scale, how close is the pilot scope to something you'd accept operationally (1 = not close, 5 = ready to run)? A one-word reply is fine.
2) If it's a 3–5, would a 10-minute sync this week to confirm network/telemetry details help move forward? I can book a slot that fits your calendar.

Why this matters: we have a small block of Dedicated capacity opening the week of Sep 20 that fits the pilot latency profile. If BlueWave can confirm telemetry allowance and a kickoff window, we can reserve that slot and keep the per-token economics within the quoted range. If not, we can revisit in late October but the earliest Dedicated window would be mid-November.

No problem either way — just trying to avoid missing a good alignment window. If it's easier, reply with a quick score and I’ll take it from there.

Best,
Avery
